text: ヤドンが　うみへ　エサを　とりにいったとき　シェルダーに　しっぽをかまれ　ヤドランになった。

structure.jp: ヤドンが　うみへ　エサを　とりにいったとき
structure.en: when a Slowpoke went to the sea to get food

structure.jp: シェルダーに　しっぽをかまれ
structure.en: it had its tail bitten by a Shellder and

patterns.name: 〜に (purpose)
patterns.explanation: A verb stem plus に before a going verb says what you go for. エサを　とりにいった = 'went to get food'.

patterns.name: 〜られる (passive)
patterns.span: シェルダーに　しっぽをかまれ
patterns.explanation: かまれる says the biting was done to it, and に shows who did it. The ending かまれ, without て, is a written way to say 'and'. シェルダーに　しっぽをかまれ = 'had its tail bitten by a Shellder and'.

patterns.name: 〜とき
patterns.explanation: とき after a verb means 'when' that happened. とりにいったとき = 'when it went to get'.
